title: shared cargo-target overwrites factory bin
body: Parallel lanes share `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/mnt/devcache/emiliano/cargo-target`, so another lane's `cargo build` can replace `debug/factory` and make `review_claims_and_since` miss the claims merge while lib unit tests still pass. Use `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/lane-1` (or rebuild `cargo build --bin factory`) before integration tests that shell out to the binary.

title: Checkpoint 1 left no evidence for FR-3
body:
**Happened:** the driver handed checkpoint 1 slices 01, 02, 03 and 4 rows handed, evidence owed for FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, FR-4; `~/.local/share/factory/runs/029-20261127-4c0a/evidence/cp-1/` holds no non-empty directory for row(s) FR-3; a link or a file counts as missing. The disk decides, whatever a record's **Prove:** line says. The record was sent back once and the second worker's record was short again.
**Options:** 1. read the last checkpoint worker's stream under `~/.local/share/factory/runs/029-20261127-4c0a/workers/`, fix what made it drop them and answer this block — a fresh checkpoint is handed the slices still unverified; 2. drive the rows by hand, save each one's evidence under `~/.local/share/factory/runs/029-20261127-4c0a/evidence/cp-<n>/<key>/`, add a record naming the slices (`factory docs log add 029 --kind checkpoint --phase checkpoint --slice <last> --covers 1,2,3`) and answer this block — a record written after this block is the owner's and stands.
**Recommended:** 1 — two workers dropping the same slices or rows points at the pack or the contract, not at one forgetful worker.
